title: Goal judges and eval cases (Jonah)
description: Two kinds (ADR 0025). EvalCase is evals/cases/<name>.yaml: one task an agent must get right, run on a definition version before it is published. Judge is the YAML front matter of evals/judges/<slug>.md, whose Markdown body is the rubric: it scores a sample of the finished production runs of the agents it names. A document with a kind is an EvalCase; one without is a judge's front matter.

slug.description: As factory.schema.json's slug: agent names and judge slugs.

relPath.description: A path relative to the root of the definition, such as ./evals/fixtures/fix-lease.patch.

judge.description: A judge's front matter. The judge's slug is its file name.

criterion.description: What it checks, in one sentence.

agents.description: The agents whose runs it scores, by spec.agents name. Empty or omitted: every agent.

outcomes.description: What the judge may answer. Each outcome's score and label are unique.

passMark.description: A score below it fails and goes to Jonah.

sample.description: The share of the agents' finished production runs it scores. 0 pauses the judge.

model.description: The model the judge run uses. Omitted: the factory's runtime.model.

case.description: An eval case. Its name is its file name.

description.description: What the agent must get right, in one sentence.

agent.description: The agent the case runs, by spec.agents name.

input.description: The item as it reaches the agent.

outputs.description: Earlier stations' outputs as the item had them, keyed by station id.

ref.description: The commit of runtime.repository the run starts from.

tries.description: How many times the case runs. It passes when every try passes.

check.description: What decides a try: exactly one of the agent's output contract, a judge or a reference patch.

contract.description: The output satisfies the contract of the agent's station.

judge.description: A judge of evals/judges/, by slug; the try passes when the judge's score reaches its pass mark.

referencePatch.description: A known-good patch the run's change is compared with.
